description: Godot 4.7 tile maps with TileMapLayer and TileSet: atlas sources, data layers, terrain autotiling and set_cell or local_to_map at runtime. Use for 2D tile levels in Godot, tiles with no collision, a click on the wrong cell or porting a deprecated TileMap. Not for Unity (`unity-tilemap-2d`), tile art (`create-game-assets`) or generation (`procedural-gen`).
